profile.headline: Engineering at JPMorgan Chase & Co.
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in Building Scalable/Fault-tolerant/Distributed Backend System. Strong engineering professional with a Master of Science (MS) focused in Computer Science from Georgia Institute of Technology.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical lead and founding engineer for the Checkout platform, designing the MVP and core architecture, including BFF (Backend-for-Frontend) design, idempotent payment flows, platform-wide API/error-code standards, and merchant subscription capabilities.
Scaled the Checkout organization from early inception by defining team boundaries across Commerce Core, Payments, Identity, and Data; interviewed and hired early engineers while providing hands-on technical mentorship and design guidance to junior ICs.
Led backend launch of Hosted Field in partnership with 4 cross-functional teams, delivering PCI/PII-compliant checkout with verification, authorization, and tokenization; standardized APIs across teams and drove adoption that increased monthly revenue by nearly 50%.
Modernized a legacy session API into RESTful, payment-type–scoped endpoints, streamlining checkout data encryption and cutting onboarding from weeks to days while reducing support tickets by ~75%.
Designed and owned the billing data platform, including a Temporal-orchestrated billing ETL and billing reconciliation pipeline, aggregating high-volume events and ensuring financial correctness across settlement, reporting and payout flows.
